entities.summary: Todd La Torre (b. 1974-02-19, St. Petersburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in St. Petersburg and United States. Known in the fields of united states, composers & musicians, americas.
